counterparty.description: Issuer / seller / insurer / service provider, as printed.

recipient.description: Person or entity the document is addressed to.

document_number.description: Document number exactly as printed, without the word 'No'/'№'.

total_amount.description: Final total to pay / insured / contract value, as a plain number with '.' decimal separator.

due_date.description: Payment deadline. null if not stated.

valid_from.description: Start of validity (policy, contract). null otherwise.

valid_until.description: End of validity (policy, contract). null otherwise.

confidence.description: Overall self-assessed confidence that all fields are correct.
